purpose: Evaluate the exact thermal kernel composed by ContinuousPlant against a previously available measured plant event. This is a development comparison, not a blind validation data set.
initialPointPolicy: Table 2 initializes the model; interpolated measured t=0 is displayed only to expose initialization bias and is excluded from error metrics.
numericalLimitMeaning: Conservation quadrature and step-refinement checks only; never physical prediction-error acceptance.
parameterPolicy: Use published initial conditions and nominal pump heat, disclosed generic capacities and volumes, and initial-only balance-derived conductances and enthalpies. Do not tune parameters using any post-initialization response.
domainStopPolicy: Preserve a failed sensitivity's finite terminal observation and mark it failed-domain. Never extrapolate it, call it a completed pass, change the parameter to avoid its failure, or report a full-window spread for an incomplete pair. Mandatory nominal/refined domain exits fail execution and block publication.
referencePolicy: Use original acquired measured curves, not RELAP5 cal curves; preserve immutable input bytes and existing channel assignments. Missing event-era geometry, actuator histories, level-to-volume mappings and instrument uncertainty prevent physical acceptance.
